evidence_basis: Yang et al. 2026, Clin Transl Med (PMID 42011973, PMC13097342; a five-page Letter, no abstract, no section headings): the whole text read from the PMC open-data bucket copy, .txt and .xml compared (11 sentence differences, all spacing around italic tags; n values identical), after a committed pre-registration that stated what had been seen. Fig 1, Fig 2 (at 300 ppi extracted from the PDF, panels E to G, I and K cropped and viewed), Fig 3, supplement docx text, Supplementary Figures S1 and S2 (converted from tiff) and Supplementary Table 1 viewed. Per-organoid data are by request and were not requested; the cited earlier same-group paper was not read.
